title: Mission for バレンタイン

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Have you decided on which chocolates to buy? I can help you find something suitable if you require help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I happen to be checking out a Valentine's Day event on my day off when Mihono Bourbon suddenly approaches me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My apologies for failing to inform you of this beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am currently carrying out my designated task of acting as a guide for this event.
choice_data_list: So basically, this is your part-time gig?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Contractually speaking, that is correct. As for why I am working here…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, some of the event's workers are running late due to traffic so Eishin Flash decided to help out at one of her friend's shops.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon ran into her here and was asked to help out too. She agreed as a way to pay Eishin Flash back for her constant support.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This mission is imperative for gaining vital knowledge and funds for Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Could I please receive your approval to engage in part-time work exclusively today?
choice_data_list: Sure, I'll notify the academy for you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. I'm looking for some chocolate truffles. Are there any that are exclusive to this event?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. Please state your preferred flavors.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Hmm… A box with a variety of sweet flavors to try out would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Search complete. I would recommend you peruse the shop over there. Their truffles boast a velvety ganache that melts into a milky flavor.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The adjacent shop offers a range of different flavors. It is the only one selling fragrant and succulent truffles containing real fruit juice.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Wow! You sure know your stuff! Okay, I'll think I'll check out that store!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her suggestions are surprisingly detailed. Had she tried each shop's chocolates beforehand? I can really feel her passion for Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff A
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for being late! Thanks for covering me last minute! I'll take over from here, so go ahead and clock out!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Mission complete. Best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your help today, Bourbon. You're a real lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: By the way, are you available after this? I wish to treat you to some cake for your trouble. Of course, your master is welcome to join us.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Cake? Thank you, but you need not provide me further compensation, as I have already received payment from the shop.
choice_data_list: Then how about we simply enjoy some cake together?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That… would be acceptable! Let the three of us have cake together, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We go to the cafe nearby, and both Mihono Bourbon and Eishin Flash order the special Valentine's Day chocolate cake.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Although it's only January, Valentine's decorations are already festooned all around. It's nice we can start trying all kinds of chocolates so early.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Every year around this time, a number of my friends come to me to learn how to make chocolates themselves.
choice_data_list: They're already preparing for Valentine's Day, huh?
They're already preparing for Valentine's Day, huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, those who are unaccustomed to making desserts often need to practice several times to get them right.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Flash, I have a question pertaining to homemade chocolates that you may have the answer to.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Homemade chocolates are inferior to those prepared by professional chocolatiers in every way.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I believe they require something unique to set them apart from store-bought ones, but what would be appropriate to add?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: For something unique, I believe it would be enough to pour your heart into the chocolate while you make them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Searching… No results found. How does one pour their "heart" into chocolate?
choice_data_list: I guess how much time you spend deciding on the chocolates also counts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain how debating over the right chocolates to give someone is a form of showing one's "heart."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In addition, making sweets from scratch takes a lot of time and effort. That in and of itself is something the recipient is sure to appreciate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Reconstructing hypothesis. The unique element that sets homemade goods apart is the inclusion of "heart," which consists of time and effort.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That's right. The thoughts and feelings poured into homemade confections have an inherent worth not present in store-bought goods.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see. That was very educational.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I read an article the other day about homemade goods which confused me, but this discussion has dispelled my concerns.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I now have a deeper understanding of Valentine's Day. Many thanks for your answers and advice.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bourbon. You finished work? I'm done with shopping.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Time to proceed with our post-work hang out. Please wait a moment while I change.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gotcha. Well, hey, you free too, Master?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nice! We got us a sponsor! All right, let's get goin'! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Okay, here's all the chocolates you asked for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan covers the table with various boxes of chocolates from different stores and starts opening all of them.
choice_data_list: Are all these Valentine's Day presents for people?
Are all these Valentine's Day presents for people?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nah, they're for us. Valentine's is like the best time of year to try out fancy chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Jordan is able to collect a vast amount of information on chocolate through her friend network. This data is vital for selecting chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: As I wished to gain access to this information as well, I suggested to Jordan we make a joint purchase of a wide selection and share them.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Bourbon's strict when it comes to choosing chocolates for friends, and I can try all kinds of goodies while she's at it, so it's a win-win situation!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us begin sampling.
choice_data_list: Are you tasting them to see which ones to get?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. Firsthand experiences form the most reliable data.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… Verdict—delicious. Its caramel flavor should be compatible with most palates.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Omigosh! This one's so yummy! Here, you give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They offer me a rich-looking dark chocolate. I bite into it, and my mouth floods with a lovely, distinctive bitterness.
choice_data_list: It's good. I like that it's not too sweet.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status—"surprise." So this is the type of chocolate you prefer…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Popular chocolate choices typically contain elevated levels of sugar. Your preference for chocolate that lacks sweetness was not anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: As I have not had much bitter chocolate before, I must expand my palate at once. I shall start with this bitter chocolate here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… Verdict—"satisfactory." Though bitter, I detect a hint of sweetness in it. I wonder how this one will compare?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, just wondering, but did you just want to binge on chocolates or something?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Was Bourbon's "gift investigation" just a front? Seeing her face stuffed with chocolates, I can't help but think Tosen Jordan is onto something.
